definitions.explanation: Morally wrong or corrupt in a fundamental way. Describes intentions, beings, or forces that are deeply harmful and malevolent.

examples.japanese: {邪悪|じゃあく}な⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
{邪悪|じゃあく}な⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{阻止|そし}→阻止：07633_soshi⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: We must stop this wicked plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{邪悪|じゃあく}な{笑|わら}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{背筋|せすじ}→背筋：13931_sesuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}る→凍る：02100_kooru⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧がした。
examples.english: Seeing the man's malicious smile sent a chill down my spine.

notes: Common collocations: {邪悪|じゃあく}な⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧ (evil power/force), {邪悪|じゃあく}な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ (evil being), {邪悪|じゃあく}な⟦{意図|いと}→意図：12625_ito⟧ (malicious intent). Frequently used in fantasy, religious, and literary contexts. Can also function as a noun: {邪悪|じゃあく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}する→退治する：25396_taijisuru⟧ (to vanquish evil). The character {邪|じゃ} means "wicked" and appears in ⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧ (hindrance, nuisance). Related: {悪|あく} (evil — more general), ⟦{極悪|ごくあく}→極悪：13214_gokuaku⟧ (heinous — even stronger), ⟦{悪意|あくい}→悪意：19922_akui⟧ (malice — focuses on intent).
